payload.reason: The dataset was collected through a combination of methods including the use of existing corpora like Tatoeba and Common Voice, and involved manual inspections and quality checks to ensure data integrity.

claims.text: The CoVoST dataset was created from 11 languages into English, utilizing over 11,000 speakers and 60 accents, with a total of 708 hours of speech collected.
An evaluation set was constructed from Tatoeba, filtering for quality by excluding samples with broken URLs and ensuring sentence lengths were appropriate.
Quality checks included manual inspections and measures of translation perplexity, ensuring high-quality translations were maintained.
